name: Draconic Attributes
body:
Your most basic attributes become even more like a dragon’s.

Prerequisite(s): Dragon disciple level 2nd

Benefit: When you take this feat, choose Strength, Constitution, or Intelligence. That score increases by 2. Your Dexterity decreases by 2. This increase is gained as if through level advancement.

Special: You may take this feat more than once. Each time, choose a different ability score to increase. You may not increase the same score more than once with this feat.
